REAL FINDING, owned by task search-index-and-embed-cache-have-no-eviction-path. This is the search index's ONLY eviction API and nothing calls it, while the insert path (IndexDrawers) IS wired. EmbedCache has no eviction API at all (Get/Put/path only), is keyed by drawer ID, and Rebuild trusts it blind — so a changed drawer keeps its stale vector EVEN THROUGH A FULL REBUILD. Vault.DeleteDrawer/MoveDrawer mutate drawers with no index eviction, so the long-lived vp mcp process keeps serving removed drawers.

REAL FINDING, owned by task partial-remote-failure-is-reported-as-success. So `vp vault pull` EXITS 0 when a remote fails. The all-succeeded predicate was written, tested, and never wired to the exit code.
